carpet.rule.fishingTreasureNoOpenWater.n: Fishing with no open water requirement
carpet.rule.fishingTreasureNoOpenWater.d: Restores pre-1.16 fishing: treasure can be caught without a 5x4x5 open water area.
carpet.rule.fishingTreasureNoOpenWater.e: true - ignore the open water requirement, normal treasure chance
imba - only treasure loot, no fish and no junk
carpet.rule.hoebedrockbreaking.name: Hoe can break bedrock
carpet.rule.hoebedrockbreaking.desc: A hoe can break bedrock. No drops (Silk Touch included), 1 durability per block (Unbreaking applies); breaking time equals a pickaxe mining stone.
carpet.rule.botnoclip.name: Bots cannot be pushed
carpet.rule.botnoclip.desc: No entity can push Carpet fake players (bots) around, so a placed bot stays put. Note: bots can still push players; the two cannot fully overlap.
carpet.rule.botnoclip.extra.0: false - vanilla (bots and players push each other)
carpet.rule.botnoclip.extra.1: true - nothing can push bots (bots can still push players)
carpet.rule.botToolSwap.name: Bots auto-equip better tools
carpet.rule.botToolSwap.desc: When a Carpet fake player picks up a tool, it switches it into the main hand if it is better: Mending wins first; otherwise the higher total enchantment level wins, with each curse level counted as -10.
carpet.rule.botToolSwap.extra.0: false - vanilla (bots keep whatever is in the main hand)
carpet.rule.botToolSwap.extra.1: true - bots auto-switch to a better picked-up tool
